rationale: The verified PDF and declaration establish that P06-T3 selects the first-order product expansion (4.8)-(4.9), not the complete surrounding Lemma 4.2. The declaration preserves the exact Householder matrices, application order, perturbed product, both unfactored and Q^T-factored single-perturbation sums, endpoint identity products, and an explicit second-order remainder.
